context: A uni student helps a teen friend troubleshoot a tech project
purpose: Teach: コンポーネント/スパム/クリップ/新潮/女神/アリス/隼/プラグ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、自作PCのコンポーネント選びで悩んでます。
lines.en: Senpai, I'm completely stuck on picking components for my custom PC build.
lines.style: Tentative, testing whether he'll actually help. Slight uplift at the end—inviting. Not performing vulnerability, just asking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 予算と用途を教えて。動画クリップ編集中心？
lines.en: Tell me your budget and what you're building for. Mostly video editing?
lines.style: Businesslike but not cold. Cuts through to the practical. Patient—he's already decided to help. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。アリスの実写ファンビデオを作りたくて。
lines.en: Yeah. I want to make a fan video for the live-action Alice film.
lines.style: Energy lifts noticeably. Quick tempo. There's passion underneath—she's admitting something she cares about. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。プラグの種類によっては電源足りないから注意な。
lines.en: Right. Depending on which plugs you go with, your power supply might bottleneck—keep an eye on that.
lines.style: Technical but accessible. No talking-down. Matter-of-fact rhythm, then slight emphasis on the caution. He's been here before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: スパムメールに「特売」って件名で安いパーツの広告くるんですが、怖くて開けません。
lines.en: I keep getting spam emails with 'sale' in the subject line advertising cheap parts, and honestly I'm too scared to open them.
lines.style: Lighter tone, almost self-deprecating. Builds to the admission. Quiet at the end—seeking validation that she's being smart, not paranoid.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正解。新潮社のレビュー記事と、公式ショップだけ参照しよう。
lines.en: Good instinct. Stick to Shinchosha's review articles and the official retailers—that's your safe bet.
lines.style: Warm nod in the voice. Brief, decisive. The kind of permission that lands because he actually means it. No hedging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 隼みたいに賢く判断します。勝利の女神、応援お願いします！
lines.en: I'll be sharp and careful like a falcon, then. Goddess of victory—please come through for me!
lines.style: Playful, slightly theatrical close. Quick-paced. A wink underneath. She's building her own luck out loud—confident now that he's in her corner.
